placements.title: Expunging operational and contractual records removes obsolete zeppelin freight fleet commitments
placements.frame: How are records, routes, and procurement knowledge surrounding the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet expunged or retained?
placements.why: Both expressions mandate the immediate and categorical erasure of institutional knowledge, routes, and procurement contracts associated with the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet. No existing narrative leaf or stratum in the graph addresses zeppelin logistics, fleet decommissioning, or data expunction.
